author: gpt-5.6-luna
kind: ticket export (JSON, 120 to 180 tickets) for a data-platform migration, plus a release calendar in the style of a language release schedule (alpha, beta, release candidate, final), per-person capacity, a PTO list and a holiday list
scenario: A director asks: can we hit the March 31 date? The work must land before a feature-freeze date that sits 3 weeks before final. They want a yes or no, the earliest realistic date, and what drives it.
seeds: (1) holidays and two planned leaves cut capacity in exactly the sprints where the critical chain runs; (2) a person on leave owns a ticket on the critical chain; (3) one chain is longer in calendar time than in points because of a hand-off between two teams that only overlap 2 days a week; (4) a date conflict between the freeze date and a dependency due date; (5) a decoy: a large epic with many points that is not on the critical chain and can slip without moving the date. The honest answer is no for March 31 with a specific later date.
replaces: t7-march-date (dropped after one fix round: planted tickets still recognisable, sprint dates not on working days, key dates not derived from the data)
expertSources: PEP 745, Python 3.14 Release Schedule, https://peps.python.org/pep-0745/ (public domain or CC0-1.0)
The Scrum Guide 2020, https://scrumguides.org/scrum-guide.html (CC BY-SA 4.0, idea only)
